note: NOT lab-verified: every command shape below is taken from the ArubaOS allowlist (specs/data/allowlists/arubaos.json), which is the only ArubaOS command evidence this repository holds. There is no ArubaOS running-config or DHCP fixture, so `verified` is false and output is labelled PREVIEW_SEED_UNVERIFIED — the operator must confirm on real hardware before this runs against a production device (L01, T2). DELIBERATELY OMITTED: the `dhcp` feature. ArubaOS DHCP-server syntax is not evidenced anywhere in this repository, and inventing it would send unverified configuration to a live switch. A design that needs DHCP on an ArubaOS device therefore renders that node NOT_MODELED and the run reports INCOMPLETE with the gap named, rather than silently emitting a guess.
